svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bar: 60 x 6 aluminium flat bar, 400 long. Four 5.5 holes, 181 each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side of centre, 15 above and below its centre line, countersunk

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the wall side so the screw heads sit flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pad: 2 mm rubber sheet 400 x 60, glued to the wall side, with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: relief holes over the screw heads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cleats: 40 x 40 x 3 angle, 50 long. One leg on the bar's room face,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes matching the bar; the other leg points into the room, on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the inner side, with two 6.6 holes 16 and 29.2 out from the bar

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face, 17 and 32 up from the cleat's lower end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the foot's centre line is 500 above the floor; the pad presses

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the wall; nothing is fixed to the wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the pad lies flat on the wall over its whole length.
